data.title: USMNT projected lineup vs. Haiti today: Mauricio Pochettino names final XI as coach - USA Today
data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs. CINCINNATI — Mauricio Pochettino will say farewell to the U.S. men's national team on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The USMNT will face Haiti in the second leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal, a match that has become less meaningful on the field after the U.S. crushed Haiti 6-0 in the first leg on Saturday, Nov. 14. Pochettino will depart after the game to take over Manchester United, and he can fully enjoy the night at TQL Stadium with the USMNT nearly in the semifinal before kickoff. That should give the Argentine the opportunity to rotate his players, though he said in his pre-match news conference that he would still name a strong team. But he will still have plenty of talent to call upon, including Folarin Balogun, Christian Pulisic and Weston McKennie, who all scored in the first leg. ## USMNT projected lineup vs Haiti.

data.content: The Toronto Blue Jays weren't happy with how last season unfolded, especially after coming off a World Series appearance the year before. Toronto's biggest issue throughout the 2026 campaign was the number of injuries that plagued its starting rotation. The top of Toronto's rotation appears to be relatively set, but figuring out the final spots could be a challenge for the organization. “The Toronto Blue Jays’ rotation was ravaged by injuries in 2026, showcasing that health is never a given in the game of baseball. While Dylan Cease, José Soriano, and Trey Yesavage should make for a strong top half of Toronto’s rotation in 2027, the rest of the options to fill out the final two spots come with a lot of question marks,” Blue Jays Nation’s Michael Coyle wrote.
